nodes.label: No-Scroll Single-Viewport Architecture
nodes.rationale: Fixed 100vh viewport; the cosmic background must fill the entire screen so the eclipse is always the hero, with no scrollbars to break immersion.

nodes.label: Why Three.js (not CSS or SVG)
nodes.rationale: Real-time shader control is needed for a true Awwwards-winning cosmic eclipse: custom glow, light rays, and bloom. CSS/SVG cannot match the depth.

nodes.label: Why TextMotion for the reveal
nodes.rationale: TextMotion handles the hero interaction: the password scramble/decrypt effect is the climactic reveal moment, deserving dedicated typography motion.

nodes.label: Why Space Mono for password chars
nodes.rationale: Monospace prevents layout shift as the scrambled characters change width during the reveal animation.
